pull.body:
# An empty wallet is not a malformed request

`req_df6a8ed49c6a46bb81765ba8039b8703` (2026-09-02 11:52Z) asked for `commandcode/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` and met:

```json
{"message": "You have insufficient credits to make this request. Please purchase more credits to continue using the service.",
 "type": "invalid_request_error",
 "code": "BAD_REQUEST"}
```

HTTP 400. It classified as `FailureKind.INVALID_REQUEST`; `FALLBACK_SKIP_KINDS` defaults to `invalid_request`; the six remaining entries on the chain were recorded as *not tried: a invalid_request failure ends the route*, and the caller got a 400.

The request was fine. The **account** was out of credits, and every one of those six entries could have answered.

## `FailureKind.QUOTA`

Produced for:

| Upstream | Phrase in the structured body | Kind | Rotate | Bench |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `402` | any of the list below | `quota` | yes | `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS`, whole key |
| `402` | none | `quota` | yes | **no** |
| `400` | one of the list below | `quota` | yes | `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS`, whole key |
| `400` | none | `invalid_request` (unchanged) | no | no |
| `400` | context-overflow wording | `context_length` (unchanged) | no | no |
| `403` | one of the list below | `quota` | yes | `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS`, whole key |
| `403` | none | `authentication` (unchanged) | yes | lockout ladder, unchanged |
| `401` | — | `authentication` (unchanged) | yes | lockout ladder, unchanged |
| `429` | — | `rate_limit` (unchanged) | yes | (key, model) bench, unchanged |

**The phrase list, as shipped** (`QUOTA_PHRASES` in `providers/failure_policy.py`, matched case-insensitively as substrings):

```
insufficient credits        purchase more credits
insufficient balance        not enough balance
not_enough_balance          quota exceeded
insufficient_quota          payment required
billing                     out of credits
credit balance is too low   creditserror
```

Command Code and the OpenAI-compatible gateways behind it; Novita (`NOT_ENOUGH_BALANCE`, "Insufficient balance."); the OpenAI machine codes; Anthropic's own "Your credit balance is too low"; OpenCode Go's `CreditsError`.

**Matcher rules.** The words are read through `providers/recovery/complaint.upstream_complaint` and through nothing else. That reader prefers the **structured** error body and prunes `input` / `body` / `request` / `payload` / `data` / `ctx` / `value` / `received` — the keys under which a pydantic-style validation error echoes the submitted request back. A prompt containing the words "insufficient credits" therefore cannot bench a key. A **phrase**, never a bare token: `credit` alone is not in the list. If the classifier is unsure it produces no `QUOTA` at all and the failure keeps the kind it has today.

## What the kind does

- **Key-shaped, not model-shaped.** `error_justifies_rotation` → `True` (`ROTATING_KINDS`), so the pool tries another key first; the executor reaches the next model only once the pool is exhausted.
- **Never ends the route.** Absent from `RouteExecutionPolicy.skip_kinds` and from `FALLBACK_SKIP_KINDS_DEFAULT`. An operator can still list `quota` explicitly; the validator and the field help name it.
- **Never counts toward the chain bench.** `BENCH_COUNTING_KINDS` is unchanged — an empty wallet says nothing about the model that was asked.
- **Benches the credential only on an exact phrase**, for the operator's existing `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS`, through the same fixed window a header-less 429 uses (`RotationEngine.note_rate_limit`). Whole-key, not scoped to a model: a wallet is not per-model. **No new number.** A bare 402 rotates and falls through and charges nothing.

`§12`'s rule text ("health changes on 401/403 and 429 only") is extended to three signals by the user's explicit decision, and every docstring, README, USAGE, ARCHITECTURE, `.env.example` and in-app Guide sentence that stated the old rule now states the new one.

## Rotation-file changes

`providers/credential_rotation.py` is the only rotation file touched (`core/credential_rotation.py` is **byte-unchanged**):

- module docstring: two key-shaped signals → three; rotation prose.
- new `QUOTA_FAILURE_CLASS = "quota"` and `QUOTA_BENCH_REASON = "credits exhausted"`.
- `ROTATING_KINDS` gains `FailureKind.QUOTA`. `CREDENTIAL_SHAPED_KINDS` is **unchanged** — whether credits charge the key depends on the evidence, not on the kind.
- `credential_failure_class` returns `"quota"` when the failure's `retry_after_seconds` is set (the classifier's evidence flag), `None` on a bare 402.
- `report_failure` routes that class to `self._engine.note_rate_limit(index, retry_after=carried, message=QUOTA_BENCH_REASON)` — the existing 429 mechanism, unscoped.
- `_charged_reason` gains a quota branch producing *credits exhausted on key `<label>` -- benched Ns*.
- `get_metrics` publishes `cooldown_reason` (`None` for every bench that did not name one, so every other bench renders byte-identically).
- new `benched_only_for_credits()`, read by the wrapper for the pool sentence.

**Invariant tests that stayed green, unmodified:** `tests/providers/test_credential_rotation.py` (all 6.0.0/6.19.0/6.20.0 cases: `test_a_429_benches_for_the_configured_window_without_a_ladder`, `test_a_run_of_generic_failures_never_benches_a_key`, `test_auth_failures_escalate_lockout_tiers`, `test_acquire_returns_minus_one_when_all_keys_benched`, `test_report_success_restores_health`, `test_error_justifies_rotation[429|400|sdk_timeout|transport|sdk_transport]`, the rotating-wrapper suite), `tests/providers/test_rotation_preemption.py`, `tests/regression/test_req_cf646ee_routing.py`, `tests/regression/test_req_cf646ee_model_scope.py`, `tests/core/test_credential_rotation*`. 85 passed in `test_credential_rotation.py`, 0 modified assertions.

## Observability

- attempt row `error_kind = quota`; credential decision `class = "quota"`.
- stored root cause: `2 keys × 1 tries: 1×400; credits exhausted on key key-…roke -- benched 55s on 400`.
- Models/Providers key-health badge: `COOLDOWN — credits exhausted`, title `benched: credits exhausted, 31s left`.
- pool sentence: `All API keys for this provider reported exhausted credits. (add or top up a key on the dashboard under Providers)`.
- every model failed for the same reason: `Every model on this route failed: all keys reported exhausted credits. (add or top up a key on the dashboard under Providers)` — wire type `billing_error` on both the Anthropic and OpenAI protocols, `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` on Gemini.

## E2E proof

Scratch MCC on `127.0.0.1:8199` (`PORT=8199` explicit, isolated `HOME`), fake OpenAI-compatible upstream on `127.0.0.1:8299`, `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=55`. The live server on 8082 was never touched.

**Two-key custom pool, `round_robin`, key 1 answers the recorded body, key 2 answers 200:**

```
--- request 1 ---
event: content_block_delta … "text":"pong"
event: message_stop
--- upstream calls ---
{"calls": [{"key": "key-broke", "model": "good-model"}, {"key": "key-funded", "model": "good-model"}]}

--- request 2 ---   (1 text_delta)
--- upstream calls ---
{"calls": [{"key": "key-funded", "model": "good-model"}]}

--- key health ---
[{"state":"COOLDOWN","cooldown_reason":"credits exhausted","cooldown_remaining":46.9,"key_label":"key-…roke", …},
 {"state":"HEALTHY","cooldown_reason":null,"key_label":"key-…nded", …}]
```

**One-key pool, two-model chain:**

```
--- upstream calls ---
{"calls": [{"key":"key-solo","model":"broke-model"}, {"key":"key-solo","model":"good-model"}]}
attempt 0: custom_fakesingle/broke-model  outcome=failed  error_kind=quota
attempt 1: custom_fakesingle/good-model   outcome=succeeded
```

**Request-detail modal (browser, `chrome-devtools-cli`):**

```
ROUTE ATTEMPTS
answered  custom_fakepool/good-model  77 ms  2 tries · 1×400 · 2 keys  key-…nded
2 keys × 1 tries: 1×400; credits exhausted on key key-…roke -- benched 55s on 400
Show 2 upstream tries
key 0 key-…roke — benched 55s (quota): credits exhausted on key key-…roke -- benched 55s
```

**Client-facing errors:**

```
{"type":"error","error":{"type":"billing_error","message":"Every model on this route failed: all keys reported exhausted credits. (add or top up a key on the dashboard under Providers)"}}
{"type":"error","error":{"type":"api_error","message":"All API keys for this provider reported exhausted credits. (add or top up a key on the dashboard under Providers)"}}
```

**Analytics → Top errors** listed both sentences; **Upstream statuses** showed `400 ×4`. **Zero console errors** (`list_console_messages --types error` → none; the one remaining message is a pre-existing a11y *issue*, not an error). Screenshots in `screenshots-quota-pr12/`.

## Tests

New, by name:

- `tests/providers/test_failure_policy.py` — `test_insufficient_credits_400_is_quota_not_invalid_request`, `test_a_bare_402_is_quota_without_a_bench`, `test_an_echoed_request_containing_the_word_credits_is_not_quota`, `test_every_measured_billing_phrase_classifies_as_quota[novita|novita_prose|opencode_go|anthropic|openai|generic_quota|generic_billing]`, `test_a_403_without_a_billing_phrase_is_still_authentication`
- `tests/providers/test_credential_rotation.py` — `test_quota_benches_the_key_for_the_rate_limit_cooldown_only_on_an_exact_phrase`, `test_quota_rotates_before_falling_to_the_next_model`, `test_a_mixed_pool_does_not_claim_every_key_ran_out_of_credits`, `test_quota_justifies_rotation_with_or_without_a_phrase`
- `tests/regression/test_req_df6a_quota.py` (new file) — `test_the_recorded_body_no_longer_reads_as_a_malformed_request`, `test_quota_never_ends_the_route`, `test_the_recorded_request_df6a_now_reaches_the_next_model`, `test_quota_rotates_to_a_funded_key_before_changing_model`, `test_the_ladder_records_the_credits_decision_against_the_key`, `test_a_route_that_is_only_out_of_credits_says_so_and_points_at_providers`
- `tests/application/test_route_health.py` — `test_quota_does_not_count_toward_the_chain_bench`
- `tests/core/test_upstream_ladder.py` — `test_root_cause_says_credits_rather_than_a_bench_and_a_status`
- `tests/config/test_admin_limits.py` — `test_the_skip_kinds_help_lists_every_kind_that_exists`
- `tests/config/test_settings_to_consumer_contract.py` — `test_quota_is_a_skip_kind_an_operator_can_choose_but_never_inherits`
- `tests/contracts/test_deadline_hint_labels.py` — `test_the_credits_pointer_names_a_page_the_nav_ships`
- `tests/api/test_admin_static_jsdom.py` + `admin_jsdom_harness.mjs` — `test_a_key_benched_for_credits_says_so_on_the_row`

Extended (they enumerate the kind vocabulary): `tests/core/test_failures.py::test_failure_kind_has_only_protocol_neutral_semantics`, `tests/core/test_failure_protocol_mapping.py::test_each_protocol_owns_failure_kind_to_wire_type_mapping`, `tests/application/test_route_health.py::KIND_BENCHES` (which `test_every_failure_kind_is_classified` forces). `tests/contracts/test_import_boundaries.py::test_config_mirrors_the_failure_kinds_it_cannot_import` passes off `config/constants.py`'s updated mirror.

Counts: `tests/contracts` 332 · `tests/api` 1301 passed / 2 failed · `tests/{providers,application,regression,core,config,cli,messaging}` 6647 passed · remainder 516 passed / 13 failed. jsdom alone `-n 0`: **195 passed** (194 before this PR).

**Baseline note:** the 15 local failures are the known pre-existing set — 11 PowerShell-installer cases in `tests/scripts/test_installers.py` and 4 websearch cases (`tests/websearch/test_registry.py`, `tests/websearch/test_settings_websearch.py`) plus 2 in `tests/api/test_web_server_tools.py` that read a real `EXA_API_KEY` out of the developer's environment. Exactly 15, none touched by this change.

`ruff format --check` repo-wide, `ruff check` and `ty check` over `src/` and `tests/` all clean. Version `6.33.1` → **6.34.0** (MINOR) with `uv lock` in the same commit.

## Residual risks

- **`billing` is the loosest token on the list.** It is a word, not a phrase, and it ships because the user named it explicitly. A gateway that says "see our billing docs" in an unrelated 400 would now classify as `quota` — which rotates and falls through rather than ending the route, so the blast radius is one wasted key rotation and one 55-second key bench, never a lost request. Every other entry is a full statement about the account.
- **A 403 with a billing phrase no longer walks the auth lockout ladder.** That is the intended trade (an unpaid account is not a revoked key), but an upstream that answers a genuinely revoked key with the word "billing" would be benched for `RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` instead of 5 minutes. None was measured.
- **The per-try ladder row records `BadRequestError`, not `quota`.** The retry frame runs *before* the provider's classifier, which is documented existing behaviour (`LadderTry.error_kind`); the attempt row and the credential decision both say `quota`. Unchanged by this PR, noted because the modal shows both.
- **A fully-benched credits pool still records `error_kind=unavailable`** on the request row, because it raises the pre-existing `ApplicationUnavailableError`. Its *message* names the credits plainly and points at Providers, but grouping by kind puts it with other pool-exhaustion rows.
- **`core/anthropic/errors.py`, `core/openai_common/errors.py` and `core/gemini_api/errors.py` were touched** although the brief said not to touch the inbound adapters. Their `_FAILURE_ERROR_TYPES` / `_FAILURE_STATUSES` tables are indexed **totally** (`table[kind]`), so a new kind without an entry is a `KeyError` at the wire boundary. Each gained exactly one line, reusing wire types that already existed (`billing_error`, `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`); no adapter logic changed. `core/gemini_api` also gained `402: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"` to its status map.
- **The pool sentence and the credits bench need a real pool.** A single-credential provider is not wrapped in `RotatingProvider`, so a one-key install gets the kind, the rotation-free fall-through and the ladder row, but no bench and no key-health badge. That is the pre-existing pool boundary, not new.

another key may have credits -- so the pool rotates first and the executor

BENCH_COUNTING_KINDS, so it never charges the model that was asked. On an exact

not per-model. A bare 402 that named no phrase rotates and falls through and
charges nothing.

The ladder row records kind=quota, the credential decision records class=quota
with the sentence "credits exhausted on key <label> -- benched Ns", the pool's
health snapshot publishes cooldown_reason so the Models page reads
"COOLDOWN - credits exhausted" instead of a throttle that will never lift on
its own, and a route where every model ended this way tells the client so and
points at Providers rather than at a limit it cannot change.
